methods.name: isEQ
methods.description: Determine if value1 equals value2 ignoring case with optional case check
methods.example:
var iseq = _cvString.isEQ('abc', 'ABC');          // returns true
var iseq = _cvString.isEQ('abc', 'ABC', true);    // returns false

parameterDef.ParamValue: True for case match else false to ignore case

methods.name: isEQ
methods.description: Determines if the 2 values are equal within the Epsilon tolerance.

methods.name: isEQN
methods.definition: isEQN(string value1, string value2, int chars…[optional], bool case)
methods.description: Determine if value1 equals value2 limited to the first number of characters with optional case check
methods.example:
var iseqn = _cvString.isEQN('abc123', 'ABC', 3);            // returns true
var iseqn = _cvString.isEQN('abc123', 'ABC', 3, true);      // returns false

parameterDef.ParamValue: True for case match else false to ignore case

methods.name: isEQWC
methods.definition: isEQWC(string value1, string value2…[optional], bool case)
methods.description: Determine if value1 equals value2 with wild cards with optional case check
methods.example:
var iseqwc = _cvString.isEQWC('abcd', 'A*D');           // return true
var iseqwc = _cvString.isEQWC('abcd', 'A*D', true);     // return false

parameterDef.ParamValue:
Right comparator with wild cards (* or ?)
* multiple characters
? single character
True for case match else false to ignore case

methods.name: GetChildren
methods.description:
Return a collection of object tree children of the current object.
 Note: as CV exposes a .NET API this will return a .NET List object and not the native JavaScript Array.
 For a basic cabinet this will return [Case, Interior, Face]
methods.returnType: System::Collections::Generic::List - array of CVAsmManaged child objects

methods.name: GetChildren
methods.description:
Return a collection of object tree children of the current object using a filter. The filter can include wild cards ? and *. There can also be multiple filters separated by the | symbol.
 Note: as CV exposes a .NET API this will return a .NET List object and not the native JavaScript Array.
 For a basic cabinet this will return [Case, Face]
methods.returnType: System::Collections::Generic::List - array of CVAsmManaged child objects

parameterDef.ParamValue: Name filter, optionally separated with a pipe, using full names or wild card characters

methods.name: ModifyParameter
methods.definition: ModifyParameter(string name, WORD action, Object value)
methods.description: Modify a parameter style or description.

parameterDef.ParamValue:
Modification type defined by one of the following constants

1.PARMOD_DESC
2.PARMOD_TYPE
3.PARMOD_STYLE

If action is equal to PARMOD_DESC then value represents text for the new description.
If action is equal to PARMOD_TYPE then value represents one of the data type enumeration values.
If action is equal to PARMOD_STYLE then value represents one of the following parameter style constants.

1.PARSTYLE_DEFAULT
2.PARSTYLE_ATTRIBUTE
3.PARSTYLE_NOTE

methods.name: ToXML
methods.description:
Write the shape to XML data format (the same as is used by CV to transfer geometry to S2M). This is useful for analyzing the core shape data.
Pro Tip: The XML data can be copied to the clipboard and then pasted into a text editor like Notepad for analysis
methods.returnType: string - Shape data as XML format

methods.name: AddCAD
methods.description:
Add a dynamic 2D CAD object to the current object. Each object keeps an internal list of dynamic CAD objects per axis, displayed the same way as manually created assembly overlay CAD, with the CAD axis origin coinciding with the object.
A copy of the CAD object is stored, so the same CAD object can be added repeatedly - change its properties between calls rather than creating a new one each time.
methods.returnType: variant - result of the add operation

parameterDef.ParamValue: The object axis the CAD is drawn on, represented by one of the Shape Axis constants
